blocks.tamil_translation: worship Allah, not associate anyone as a partner with Him, establish Salah, give Zakat, fast in Ramadan, perform Hajj, enjoin good, forbid evil, and say Salam to your family. Whoever falls short in any one of these has abandoned a part of Islam. Whoever abandons all of them completely has turned his face away from Islam altogether.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اْلإِسْلَامُ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَسْهُمٍ: اْلإِسْلَامُ سَهْمٌ، وَالصَّلوةُ سَهْمٌ، وَالزَّكَاةُ سَهْمٌ، وَحَجُّ الْبَيْتِ سَهْمٌ، وَالصِّيَامُ سَهْمٌ، وَاْلاَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ سَهْمٌ، وَالنَّهْيُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ سَهْمٌ، وَالْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ سَهْمٌ، وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ لَا سَهْمَ لَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار وفيه يزيدبن عطاء وثقه احمد وغيره وضعفه جماعة وبقية رجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد:١٩١/١
blocks.tamil_translation: “There are eight most important shares in Islam: having Iman is one share, Salah is one share, giving Zakat is one share, performing Hajj is one share, fasting in the month of Ramadan is one share, enjoining good is one share, forbidding evil is one share, striving in the path of Allah is one share. Whoever has none of these important shares of Islam has certainly failed.” Hazrat Hudhaifah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اْلإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تُسْلِمَ وَجْهَكَ لِلّهِ، وَتَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةَ وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Islam is that you hand yourself over to Allah (in beliefs and deeds)
